conditions.method: first-principles BTE, direct inversion of the scattering tensor in kALDo

source.detail: "Our first-principles BTE calculations give kz = 2.84 Wm-1K-1 and kr = 39.0 Wm-1K-1" (p. 13). "The solution of the linearized phonon BTE was computed by directly inverting the scattering tensor on a 21x21x17 mesh of q-points, as implemented in kALDo" (p. 23). Phonon dynamics and thermal conductivity of PtSe2 thin films (D. Donadio group and collaborators), arXiv:2111.13395
